nodes.description: Public owner address state variable of Owned; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the onlyOwner authorization anchor across BuyZygoma.
Pending owner address state variable in Owned; written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Boolean circuit-breaker flag in ZygStop; read by the stoppable modifier and the buyToken require(!stopped) check.
ERC20Interface reference to the Zygoma token contract; target of the external transfer performed in buyToken.
Internal pure library addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Internal pure library subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
Internal pure library multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
Internal pure library division with require(b > 0) zero-divisor guard.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender, granting the deployer privileged control.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner into newOwner.
Two-step ownership acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and rotates owner.
onlyOwner function that sets stopped = true, halting payable buys.
onlyOwner function that resets stopped = false, resuming payable buys.
onlyOwner/notThis function that checks the balance and performs a raw ETH transfer to an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner/validAddress/notThis function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 contract and asserts the result.
Internal sale function that requires !stopped and msg.value >= 0.001 ether, computes amount = msg.value * 350000 and forwards tokens to msg.sender.
Payable fallback function guarded by stoppable that delegates to buyToken.
Caller-controlled address, the only untrusted input present; used for ownership, authorization checks and as token/ETH recipient.
Raw ETH transfer of an owner-specified amount to an arbitrary, caller-influenced recipient address.
External call to an owner-supplied token contract followed by an assert on the unchecked boolean return value.
External ERC20 transfer executed on the stored token address with msg.sender as recipient and a value derived from msg.value.
Unchecked integer multiplication of msg.value by the hard-coded rate 350000, performed without SafeMath and therefore overflow-prone.
ERC20Interface constructor parameter of BuyZygoma that is written into the zygomaAddress state variable.
Caller-supplied address parameter of transferOwnership that is stored into newOwner.
Recipient address parameter of withdrawTo, constrained only by notThis.
Withdrawal amount parameter of withdrawTo, bounded by require(amount <= this.balance).
Arbitrary ERC20Interface contract parameter of withdrawERC20TokenTo, validated only against the zero address.
Token recipient address parameter of withdrawERC20TokenTo.
Token amount parameter of withdrawERC20TokenTo passed to the external transfer call.
Local variable in buyToken holding the product of msg.value and 350000 before being forwarded to the token transfer.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, deriving privilege directly from caller identity.
Constructor writes the caller identity into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership relies on the owner state variable through the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner before executing transferOwnership.
_newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the new address into the newOwner state variable.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner as the authorization source for msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to allow the ownership rotation.
acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner, transferring control authority.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after acceptance.
stop writes true into the stopped state variable, affecting contract availability.
stop is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
start resets the stopped state variable to false.
start is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
withdrawTo is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading the owner state variable.
withdrawTo executes the raw ETH transfer to the supplied address.
the 'to' parameter is consumed by withdrawTo.
owner-supplied recipient address is passed to an external ETH transfer.
the 'amount' parameter is consumed by withdrawTo.

withdrawERC20TokenTo invokes the external token transfer operation.

the recipient parameter is consumed by withdrawERC20TokenTo.
the recipient parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.

buyToken requires !stopped, reading the circuit-breaker state variable.

the overflow-prone local amount is passed to the external token transfer.
the unchecked product flows into the external token transfer call.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external token transfer, and the call precedes any state finalization.
the stored zygomaAddress token contract is the target of the external transfer.
buyToken executes the external token transfer operation.

the _zygomaAddress parameter is stored into the zygomaAddress state variable.
the BuyZygoma constructor initializes the zygomaAddress token reference.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _zygomaAddress only exists to initialize state inside the BuyZygoma constructor and can be folded into that function.
Parameter _newOwner has no independent semantics and is merged into transferOwnership, the only function that consumes it.
Recipient parameter 'to' of withdrawTo flows directly into the raw ETH transfer unsafe operation.
Amount parameter of withdrawTo flows directly into the raw ETH transfer unsafe operation.
Token contract parameter is used solely as the external call target in the ERC20 transfer unsafe operation.
Recipient parameter of withdrawERC20TokenTo flows directly into the external token transfer call.
Amount parameter of withdrawERC20TokenTo flows directly into the external token transfer call.
Local variable amount is the direct product of the unchecked msg.value*350000 multiplication and can be merged into that unsafe operation.
